general_information.name: UH, SORRY — DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY CARD OR, LIKE, THE ONE ON MY DOCUMENTS? I ALWAYS GET MIXED UP WITH THIS STUFF. IT’S JAMAL… AND THEN WHITFIELD, I THINK, BUT MAYBE YOU WANT IT IN FULL?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been… hard to say cleanly. For the last about eight months I’ve had this growing feeling that the neighbours are watching me, talking about me, and sometimes I hear my name called when nobody’s there. I keep wondering if it’s real or if I’m just getting myself worked up, but it’s enough that I stopped going to my college course. I’m trying to figure out what’s going on, really.
current_concerns.goals: I want to work out what is happening to me, and get back to my course.
